cities.indianCommunityNotes: India-born residents concentrate in Middlesex County NJ (Edison/Iselin area), Queens, Hudson County NJ (Jersey City), Nassau, Somerset and Bergen counties. Middlesex is the largest county concentration (100,396).

visual.skylineDescription: Dense Manhattan grid of boxes; Empire State Building as stepped setbacks with a thin spire, One World Trade as a tapering square tower with spire, Chrysler crown; water on three sides; Jersey City towers across the Hudson.
visual.weather: Four seasons; humid hot summers, snowy winters.

cities.stateRules: New York issues driver's licences regardless of status (Green Light Law; federal government has sued, outcome not checked). In-state tuition and health coverage rules not verified.
